units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 229:5">Sifré Deut. 229</cite> <he>כמה הוא מקום מַעֲגִילוֹ וכ׳</he> how large a railing is required around the place where one puts his rolling machine? Three handbreadths, opp. to <he>בית דורסין</he> the part of the roof used for moving about; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 930:14">Yalk. ib. 930</cite> <he>מַעֲגָלוֹ</he>.
